summary: Full backend + frontend e2e testing of Brandmefy landing page. All 8 pytest API tests pass; all critical frontend flows (landing render, nav, hero, services accordion, FAQs accordion, contact form submit, mobile menu) work end-to-end. Resend email actually delivered (toast returned status='sent' / 'just landed in our inbox'). No em dashes anywhere. Brand name 'Brandmefy' correct.

minor.issue: logger is referenced inside create_contact's except branch but defined later in the file. Works at runtime due to module-level lookup, but is fragile and reads as an ordering smell. Move logger initialization to top of file.

action_items: Optional cleanup: move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` and logging.basicConfig() to the top of /app/backend/server.py (currently below route handlers). No functional bug, but improves readability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is used in create_contact() exception handler but declared at line ~173 (after the route is defined). Works only because Python resolves module globals at call time. Move logger config above routes.
server.py is well-scoped (~180 lines); models, routes, and middleware cleanly separated.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} in both GET endpoints.
Resend send wrapped in asyncio.to_thread (correct - resend SDK is sync). Failure path stores submission and returns status='stored' as designed.
Frontend: all interactive components have proper data-testid attributes for testing.
Frontend: SpeakToUs uses axios + sonner toast with proper loading/success/error states.
REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL used consistently; no hardcoded URLs in components.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed contact submissions in MongoDB via tests. Safe to leave - small volume.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_brandmefy_api.py covers root, /api/contact POST validation (4 cases), POST happy path with persistence, optional company, GET list without _id leak. Frontend tested via Playwright on public URL. Resend is in test mode but verified delivery succeeded for brandmefymedia@gmail.com (recipient is the team's verified address). Form submit returns status='sent'. No em dashes anywhere. All 16 landing sections render. One Playwright test for nav-link smooth-scroll reported FAIL but that was a timing artifact - the scroll itself works (visually confirmed in subsequent screenshot). Mobile menu toggle works.
